claude_proposed_widenings.name: MagicItemRecord + magic_item kind in UnitRecord
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: UnitRecord has no 'magic_item' kind. types.ts only defines SpellRecord | ClassFeatureRecord | MasteryRecord. The TAXONOMY lists magic_item_root as a v4 source atom but the surface has never been extended to include it. All magic items are blocked at this level.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Weapon (Any Simple or Martial), Rare — the item is a magic item, a category absent from UnitRecord

claude_proposed_widenings.name: passive_weapon_bonus family (always-on +N to attack and damage rolls)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The +1 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls is always-on while wielding; no existing family (activation, on_hit_trigger, ongoing_effect) models a passive item property that requires no activation, no quota, and no concentration. A new family is needed.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: creature_type_filter on on-hit trigger (Giant-only rider)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: MasteryTrigger only gates on weapon_hit / weapon_hit_melee_only with no creature-type predicate. Giant Slayer's rider fires only against creatures of type Giant. Encoding this without a filter would dishonestly apply the rider to all weapon hits.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: When you hit a Giant with this weapon, the Giant takes an extra 2d6 damage...

claude_proposed_widenings.name: weapon_damage_type as a DamageType variant or special alias
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: DamageType is a closed enum of specific damage types (slashing, piercing, etc.). Giant Slayer deals 'damage of the weapon's type', which is resolved at runtime from the weapon. There is no 'weapon_damage_type' or 'inherited' variant in DamageType.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: the Giant takes an extra 2d6 damage of the weapon's type
